diagnostics.message: Explicit quarter allocation precedes additive global fermata seconds. Grace and principal attacks use the final after-boundary clock: a hold at group onset finishes before grace attacks and boundary controls; holds inside or at the nominal principal endpoint are unsupported. Written grace markers remain zero-length.
Added 1 seconds from explicit interpretation policy, not from authored sign; strict sustain-selected-anchor sound policy.
Explicit sustain-selected-anchor policy replaces the ordinary terminal gate with the exact written endpoint and includes its hold; ties remain one attack.
Every grace duration derives from the caller's exact quarter allocation; no slash, written-value or equal-division duration was inferred.

Explicit following-principal allocation: graces sound in source order for their full allocation; principal sounds for 23/25 of the remaining nominal duration. Written markers and source events remain unchanged. Pitch, staff and instrument stay resolved at the written anchor; numeric dynamics use actual attacks and absolute control times.
